references.text: Here reference is made to Isaiah 56:7, where God's house is spoken of as a house of prayer for all nations, which Jesus quotes to criticize temple practices.
Psalm 69:9 can be seen as an indirect reference through Jesus' actions in the temple, reflecting his zeal for God's house, as also mentioned in this psalm.
Matthew 21:13 contains a parallel event where Jesus quotes the same passage from Isaiah when he cleanses the temple, showing consistency in the message about the temple being a house of prayer.
Luke 19:46 also reports on this event, where Jesus quotes Isaiah to condemn the misuse of the temple, emphasizing the importance of this teaching.
